baseline.latency_evidence: aggregate-only evidence could discard signed improvements and did not enforce a promotion regression budget
baseline.continuation_evidence: legacy durable evaluation jobs could survive into the normal drain lifecycle
baseline.hard_negative_evidence: forbidden identities were not proven against the current canonical project::file row
baseline.leakage_evidence: raw substring checks treated lexical containment such as data in metadata as oracle leakage

metrics.paired_latency: every positive case retains exact treatment, control, signed delta, classification, and a sample-bound digest; maximum positive per-case delta budget is 20ms
metrics.continuation: restart and drain remove evaluation-owned durable jobs before scheduling, rescheduling, completion, steering, or event emission and persist a bounded owner-only cleanup receipt
metrics.hard_negative: every hard-negative case binds one exact canonical project::file memory ID to a surfaced current-state entry
metrics.leakage: token, contiguous phrase, meaningful-token, and semantic-topic overlap replace raw substring matching

holdout.kind: saved graph recall synthetic holdout and fail-closed unit receipts

failure_ledger.failure: legacy latency statistics discarded negative deltas and legacy rounding did not preserve signed improvements
failure_ledger.resolution: added finite signed statistics and signed rounding, then bound promotion aggregates to exact samples
